title: 按钮
summary: 「做个按钮」只说了能点。先定这一区的主操作、次操作还是弱操作，一区只能有一个面状。
summaryEn: “Make a button” only says it can be clicked. First decide whether this region’s action is primary, secondary, or weak — and keep only one filled button.
asksEn: How heavy should this action be?

links.when: 按钮重量不是填还是选
links.whenEn: button weight is not fill versus pick
